main_text.p: Psaltes, his quidem uerbis: In angustia mea inuocaui Iehouam, & ad Deū meū clamaui: audiuit ex palatio suo uocem meam: & clamor meus in conspectu eius peruenit ad aures eius. Et cōmota est & tremuit terra: & fundamenta montium nutárunt, & sese mouerunt, quia ira erat ei. Ascēdit fumus per nares eius, & ignis uorax ex ore eius: prunæ ardebant corā eo. Et inclinauit cœlos, & descendit: & caligo erat sub pedibus eius. Et ueheba-tur super Cherub, & uolabat, & agitaba-tur super alas uenti. Posuit tenebras latibulum suum circa se, & tabernaculum suum, tenebras inquam aquarum, nubes ætheris. Præ splendore coram ipso nubes eius transierūt: grando adfuit & prunæ ignitæ. Tunc intonuit ex cœlis Iehouah: & Altissimus edidit uocem suam, grandinem & prunas ignitas. Et emisit sagittas suas, & dissipauit eos: & fulgura multiplicauit, & disiecit illos. Tunc apparuerunt gurgites aquarum, & retecta sunt fundamenta orbis, ab increpatione tua Iehouah, & à flatu uenti iræ tuæ. Emisit manum ex alto, apprehendit me, & extraxit me ex aquis multis. Eripuit me ab

page.notes: The text ends mid-word "ab" at the foot; the next word is cut off by the page edge and left out. Several words have doubtful readings: "corā" (coram), "ueheba-tur" (uehebatur), "edidit uocem" printed "uocem" with a long-s-like form, "Iehouah" and "Iehouam" as printed. The printed "Emifit" in the second half reads "Emisit" in the first occurrence and "Emisit" in the next, kept as printed. Page is otherwise clean; no marginal notes or footnotes visible.
